rationale: The unit tests call Control.enable_events through app.control (a cached_property returning Control). Celery's test_*.py files are outside the indexed corpus (259 of 418 .py files analyzed; only non-test helpers under t/ appear), so this is a coverage gap no rule targets. The worker/control.py:345 grep hit is an unrelated worker-side command handler, and the CLI uses broadcast(command) rather than this method.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The tp verdict is wrong: it dismissed the unrelated worker handler correctly but missed the direct test calls in t/unit/app/test_control.py.
